reviews.title: No support for syncing identities/aliases from Gmail, nor signatures
reviews.text: Syncing configs between devices is great, my main interest in it, but not being able to import what’s already in Gmail in terms of a few dozens sender aliases and sigs is a showstopper, sadly.

reviews.title: Select ALL function disappeared!
reviews.text: I loved this app and I paid for it at the very beginning. But recently I found that one of the most useful function “select all” which makes Airmail different from others is disappeared. What happened? Please help!

reviews.title: No free version - only $50/year version
reviews.text: This is a sufficient e-mail app ONLY if you oay for it. It is advertised as having a free tier that you can use without a subscription. The thing is, the advertisement for the subscription pops up so frequently in the free version and blocks the entire screen making it impossible to use the app. The features in this app are not worth $50/year and the free version is unusable because the add pops up so often. I understand that the company need to charge to generate revenue. My issue is that the free version is unusable due to your adds so it's misleading to advertise a free version when it's simply not usable! By telling customers it's available, you create the expectation that theycan efficiently use the free teir which is NOT TRUE! Now that you have failed to meet the expectations you set, you have created a customer that actively dislikes your product and actively discourages people from using it. Bottom line - this app only works if you pay $50/year for it. The free version is unusable.

reviews.title: Used to love
reviews.text: I was the biggest supporter of this app since they first started. I’ve always paid and subscribed. Even subscribed when they increased their prices astronomically. I’ve never left an app review before but I’m truly so discouraged at what a mess it’s been lately. It never matches what’s on my desktop, emails missing from my inbox, the list goes on. Sadly canceling my subscription and finding something else.

reviews.title: Aggressive paywall ruins the experience
reviews.text:
A full-screen subscription popup appears almost immediately after opening the app, and the close button only shows up after a long, deliberate delay. It then keeps coming back while I'm trying to use the app. This is a textbook dark pattern: it forces users to stare at a sales pitch instead of reading their email.
I understand developers need to earn money, and a clear, dismissible offer in the settings or a one-time banner would be perfectly fair. But blocking the whole screen with a hidden exit button is disrespectful to your users and makes the app frustrating to use daily.
I'm switching to another mail app unless this changes. Please make the close button available instantly and stop showing the paywall repeatedly.

reviews.title: Stop constantly showing the subscribe to pro screen
reviews.text: Stop constantly showing the subscribe to pro screen

reviews.title: Who doesn’t love a constant notification to pay pay pay pay
reviews.text:
This app is a four star app if you weren’t constantly having to dismiss the CLAIM OFFER page that blocks your entire view (update, they made it even worse because you can’t dismiss it for ten seconds. Ten seconds, it just blocks your ability to do anything)

AND I BOUGHT THIS APP. I was an original purchaser of the one-time price. Way to treat your customers

reviews.title: A great email app
reviews.text:
I've used Airmail for a couple of years now and I find it to be a great email app.

The app is easy to use, is clear in its layout and has lots of customisable areas (even down to the colour of app icon). 

I use the pro version and recently started to receive pop ups asking me to upgrade to the pro version although subscribed to the end of October. 

I contacted support and this has been rectified.

Had it not been for this bump in the road I would have given 5 stars.

UPDATE Oct 2026

My subscription ends at the end of this month. I have used Airmail for a number of years and found it better than competitors such as Spark. 

I like the clean interface and the way it interacts. Now and again it throws out a bug and doesn't behave as it should but these are minor.

All that said, the developer now intends to change the costs of my subscription from £9.99 to £39.99 which I think is a bit out of order. I retained the lower price because of the length of time I've used the app but obviously loyalty has its limits. After getting notified of the price hike I'm getting peppered with prompts to rate the app. 

So now I'll be leaving at the end of the month. AI is a wonderful tool so I'll be making my own email client

reviews.title: CONSTANTLY CRASHES ON IPHONE
reviews.text: Opens for a split second then completely goes away. If you have a lot of email addresses, the left side bar doesn’t scroll so that you can Select one if there are too many. Developer needs to rework the interface. Doesn’t matter I guess because it completely crashes the second I try to open it, using the latest iOS 27.

reviews.title: Annoyed
reviews.text: Some things don’t work as well as they once did. Now every time I open the damn app it asks me for a review. I don’t pay for that!

reviews.title: Hate new feature
reviews.text: What a pain to delete now instead of the previous one swipe. Looking for an alternative. What a retro move!

reviews.title: From the best to the worst
reviews.text: Airmail used to be the gold standard. How the mighty have fallen. Between the rug pull on the lifetime price to the 4 x price increase from £9.99 to £39.99 and now the app is a buggy mess. Been a user for 10+ years and it’s time to say goodbye.

reviews.title: Ditching Airmail
reviews.text:
I’ve been loyal to Airmail since launch back in 2013 for the Mac. It has bugs and hiccups but I was loyal to the beautiful design, indie not a greedy developer. It came in at a critical time when Canary went out of service and there was no replacement. It grew through the years and from time to time we loyal users participate as much as we can. Up until it tuned into another subscription service which is shameful and outrageous for anyone against this business module. I stopped using it for months then decided to go back to it as there was still no good alternative and the annual subscription was $10. I didn’t like forcing us to subscribe and preferred buying a new version every couple of years or donating, etc. The worst part was stripping features from the app that you always bought and paid for and putting them behind a pay wall! That’s not an honest, decent or friendly behaviour, especially for loyal long-term customers who stood on your side for years when you were unknown. 

Now  I find myself forced to ditch it forever as the developer has decided once again to screw his loyal users and raise the annual subscription x4!!! Really? Now when there are tons of free or cheaper alternatives? Do you know Apple Mail has come a long way and finally can stand on its feet, especially with its unmatched Apple Intelligence integration with on-device processing, no 3rd party servers, etc?! 
Do you know how much we risk using 3rd-party mail clients?! 
Well, continue sleeping under th

reviews.title: Broken todoist
reviews.text: I’m mainly using this app to be able to send emails to my todo list to make sure I respond to everything. But the todoist integration has gone from barely functional to fully broken  now on iOS, and it’s extremely clunky on macOS. iOS can’t even tell that todoist is installed anymore, and macOS dumps the email subject and the entire deep link text into the task name, which makes it very hard to read the resulting task. This is clearly not a priority for this app despite being part of what you pay for. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Glitches, zero customer service
reviews.text:
I’ve been a very loyal subscriber for almost a decade. When they recently increased (by a lot!) their annual fee, I paid it because I loved the app. 

BUT: Things are now so bad, making you want to scream at the inconsistency, ZERO customer service, and worse, the stress from an email app that’s supposed to REDUCE email stress!!

I’m not asking for much: JUST THE FEATURES I PAID FOR!!!

reviews.title: Customer Support
reviews.text: Customer support is lacking and their responses do not take into account the information provided. Simple problems become confusing exchanges leading nowhere.

reviews.title: Latest update breaks archive swiping
reviews.text: You can no longer easily just swipe to archive. The most common use of an email program just got hard. So stupid.

reviews.title: Was great...not now!
reviews.text: I have been a subscriber since 2019. I loved the app, it worked great which is why I dealt with the huge subscription increase but since the last update it is awful. When you make changes in the settings they don't save. It glitches and we seem to have lost settings. Support is nonexistent, I will be looking for another mail app.

reviews.title: This was my email app for years
reviews.text:
I’ve used airmail for about 5 years and it’s been great until recently. Lately I get notifications that I have so many new emails but it won’t download them. 

On top of that, it’s time to renew my subscription and it has gone up from £9.00 per year to £50.00 per year. Time to say goodbye

reviews.title: Overpriced
reviews.text: They changed the subscription from 9.99 to 39.99. Ridiculous. This app barely gets any updates to justify the price increase. I would have stayed at 9.99 but 39.99 is way too much for this app.

reviews.title: Recent update causing issues
reviews.text: I've been a big fan of the AirMail app for several years now. I manage five separate email inboxes between work and personal and it allows me to keep everything organized. However the most recent update that happened a day ago has completely changed the way that I interact with AirMail and now my main personal email account is not updating in the app. I'm not getting emails and I can't figure out a way to fix it. I've been on your support page and no one has responded

reviews.title: Money grab
reviews.text: Bought this for 4.99 years ago.  Then they added subscription and now it’s 400% more than initial cost.  Meanwhile app hasn’t changed much.  Loyalty has its limits and this $50 reup fee just broke the camels back.

reviews.title: Good Pales Compared to The Bad
reviews.text:
9/17/26: Developer shows up just in time to raise the sub price and and rebrand it as, "... for Gmail Outlook Mail." Unbelievable! Yep, STILL! 6/2/26: STILL! Still in business. How are they even getting above 3 stars, much less 4 stars? If you have one or two email accounts that are low-volume, maybe, but then the incessant hounding about needing more money ... Somebody make it stop. I repeat, this developer is exactly what is wrong with subscriptions for software development at this level. BTW - Mail is finally a fully matured product, and if it's been awhile since you've tried, now is a pretty good time to try it again. 1/26/25: WOW! I can't believe these developers are still in business. Just WOW! You've been warned by this and many other reviews. JUST REPEATING [8/6/24]: If you have one email account and want to pay a never ending subscription fee, then go for it, otherwise read below. Subscriptions for consumer software development are a total joke about 98% of the time, and this app is a poster child for why.
UPDATE [12/26/20]: Final point for Airmail from a paid customer. This piece of software and many many others like it, (not just email clients), are exactly what's wrong with subscriptions. Less quality, less attention, less performance and less updating. Subscriptions need to go away. UPDATE [12/7/19]: Still looking back. Incredibly, instead of making dramatic improvements they’ve turned to subscriptions as a way of delivering even less while locking us and our ve

reviews.title: Was good, isn’t now
reviews.text: Too much feature creep at the expense of things I actually want to use. No longer lets me use keyboard to delete an email? No more “keyboard” setting in the settings (as their website suggests there should be) to fix this? Sorry, I’m done.

reviews.title: Likely end of life - do not subscribe
reviews.text:
I have been a long time subscriber - over 5 years. I even stuck with it when the search stopped working because of their “AI” features. But now they just changed the price from $9.99 a year to $39.99 a year! Who 4X’s the price overnight on their subscribers? That only happens when a company knows their product can’t keep up (with the new improved ios27 mail in particular) and is going to lose all their subscribers except the ones not paying attention…and if they aren’t paying attention, squeeze them for all they are worth.

I was going to stick with them and don’t even mind the price for how often I use it, but this is such a strong signal of end of life that I am switching now so I don’t get caught short when they stop improving and maintaining the product.

reviews.title: Not worth the price
reviews.text:
This app used to be good but it doesn’t share labels between iOS and MacOS very well. There’s numerous glitches that are frustrating such as blocked or spam mail not being able to delete or constantly reappearing.

And then there’s a massive yearly price increase from 9.99 to 39.99! Nope! Not worth it.

Subscription cancelled.

reviews.title: Annoying popups
reviews.text: The app looked nice and it was easy to set up a few accounts, but I saw the upgrade pop-up every time I opened the app. That kind of pushy sales nonsense is intolerable.

reviews.title: Lost customer
reviews.text: The app losing authorization with Microsoft accounts requiring them to be deleted and reconnected on a routine basis was bad enough but I have to agree with others that raising the price from 9.99 to 39.99 is a bridge too far. I will not be renewing my subscription as there is not enough value in the app to justify the increase. Would give zero stars if possible.

reviews.title: Price Increase
reviews.text: Great app. But a 400% price increase is wild. Especially for those who have been with the app since the jump. If increase, should be gradual for those people.

reviews.title: This app is trash.
reviews.text: Every time I open this piece of garbage it asks me to buy it and makes me wait on the screen. Now it asks for a review. So they are getting one. Don’t waste your time unless you want another app to keep email separate.

reviews.title: Bugs galore
reviews.text: I’ve been using Airmail on my iPhone and iPad for a long time and really enjoyed the app until about a month ago. I don’t know what happened but developers need to get on it. The update is just full of bugs and the app hangs up or does something weird almost every time I use it now. Also going from $9.99 to $39.99 ain’t it guys. Too bad. It really used to be my favorite mail app.

reviews.title: So close…
reviews.text: I purchased this specifically to manage multiple aliases from multiple custom domains with iCloud Plus. There are major issues with the mobile app that cause fatal errors on replies it’s nearly unusable.  If they don’t fix, I’m going to abort and eat the $40.

reviews.title: Airmail Unlimited
reviews.text:
I have used Airmail for number of years, last year there was a change however my iOS devices did not present like my Airmail on the Mac, the iPad and iPhone were changed from email inboxes to just labels, not helpful not productive! I did seek support for this situation but received no help or solution.
The icing on the cake has arrived from Apple to advise me that Airmail is changing the cost of Airmail Pro from £9.99 per year to £39.99 per year.
With this in mind I have now cancelled my subscription to Airmail, I tried to utilise Mozilla Thunderbird to no avail, I have now enlisted Apple Mail, so far so good at no cost.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: I bought this app for a lifetime price, then Airmail decided to charge 9.90$ nonetheless. They now increase the price to a whopping 39.90$ a year. What a disingenuous grift. Stay away.

reviews.title: Does not allow sorting options
reviews.text: Need ability to sort by subject

reviews.title: $40/yr for an email client
reviews.text: I have been using this for several years with my private email server. The only reason I was using it is because it can be configured to not filter mail through a third party server. I was begrudgingly paying the $10/yr fee the past few years. But they decided to increase it to $40/yr. Absolutely not. Goodbye.

reviews.title: Keeps getting more buggy
reviews.text:
Been a user for many years, tolerated little degradations in quality for so long, I can’t take it anymore.

First it was stuttering UI, but the visual was so good, I lived with it. Then the badge count is always 10 when I have NO unread message, so I had to turn off its badge. Now it keeps notifying me of messages I’ve marked as read DAYS ago. Every day. This is it. It’s negative for me. I don’t mind the price hike, but paying more to get a much worse experience?

reviews.title: SO Much nag for pro version
reviews.text: Currently testing to possibly switch from Spark, however about every time I open the app I get a full screen nag to update to pro. Not sure how much longer I can stand this

reviews.title: 400% increase in subscription cost.
reviews.text: Price of subscription going from 9 dollars to 39.99. That’s a big jump.  I have been using your app for years, but no more.  Gmail app is just as good.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: This app was at one time decent and previously you could count on timely tech support. Not anymore!! I moved from an older Mac Pro to a Mac Studio and now forced to use the “new upgraded version” of the app. Simple things like trying to get my business logo to load cleanly created all kinds of HTML errors. Once I figured that out with absolutely zero help from tech support I realized the read receipts plug in no longer works. This app is absolute garbage and tech support is a joke. Stay away!! Please do not waste your money or time on this.

reviews.title: way too many bugs
reviews.text: there are simply too many bugs for an app of this age. i’m tired of fighting with it. support is miserable. each release just says ‘bugfix’.  that’s not good enough. i give up. switching to another mail client app.

reviews.title: Constantly crashes on iPhone 16 Pro Max. You won’t be able to check your email.
reviews.text: Don’t bother to use this email app. It won’t work on your iPhone or your iPad under the latest OS, tap the icon it just crashes and goes away.

reviews.title: 4x Price Hike
reviews.text: What warrants the price increase from $10/year to $40 all of a sudden?

reviews.title: Buggy and they don't care
reviews.text: iPhone and Mac version of the app have a few bugs, but iPad version is so buggy that it's almost unusable. Some of the bugs have persisted for years. Despite reporting many to they developers, they just don't care. I'm an idiot for still paying the subscription out of pure inertia.

reviews.title: Goodbye
reviews.text: This app is good at what it does, but still it is glitchy. However, I am not, and will not pay £30 increase in price for subscription of this email client. This is pure greed at it’s worse. Not only that, nothing new has been added or implemented. I consider a 300% price increase a severe cruel and sadistic blow to its loyal customer base. If the developers can do this, what else are they capable of doing. I for one, even though a long loyal customer, have cancelled my subscription, and deleted the app. All that remains to do now is simply bid farewell.

reviews.title: Shockingly bad and unworkable. Developers don’t seem to care!
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for years but recently it has become unusable and I literally mean that it no longer pulls emails from outlook. Are we supposed to uninstall/reinstall and go through the set up process again, every time I want to read my email? Don’t bother look elsewhere.

reviews.title: Broke outlook
reviews.text: Since last update they broke compatibility with Outlook/Hotmail accounts. Now says ‘push services error’ on anything Outlook. Gmail still fine. That’s unacceptable.

reviews.title: Constant popup daily popup
reviews.text: If you’re going to offer a free version, don’t popup a message asking me to buy the paid version every time I open the app.

reviews.title: Subscription price QUADRUPLED.
reviews.text: I’ve happily used this for years, but the new yearly subscription price is ridiculous. I’ve cancelled and I’ll be looking for a new email app.

reviews.title: Price increase
reviews.text: Same features for a $10 sub increase. Greedy

reviews.title: Subscription fee hike
reviews.text: I will not be continuing my subscription as it jumped from $10/yr to $40/yr

reviews.title: Used for years, not now
reviews.text: I have used this app for years and it has been brilliant but raising the subscription by £30 is a step too far.  Sub cancelled and back to Gmail app.  Come back to me when you have worked out your pricing.

reviews.title: Don’t Do It
reviews.text: I first found this app about 6 years ago. I loved it. I downloaded it again a month or so ago. I paid for it. Again. This time it turned out to be garbage. Complete garbage. For the first time ever I asked Apple for a refund. I got the refund. I chocked it up to my bad. About 20 minutes ago the refund I got a month or so ago was reversed. What BS. If you are even slightly concerning buying app, do not do it.

reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: Lack of updates or support beginning to show.

reviews.title: Not even cool
reviews.text: Prices get raised because it costs money to maintain a top flight app. Okay. But then months pass without an update?! Bugs and issues all over the place. No, no, no, no, no...

reviews.title: Pro pop up
reviews.text: I am so tired of having to navigate around your Airmail Pro pop up which comes up EVERY TIME l switch back and forth from another app to yours.  Lord, l get doing advertising but this is over the top and INCENTIVIZES me to NOT purchase your product.  Tone it down please.

reviews.title: Airmail for iOS
reviews.text: Paid subscriber for many years…DEEPLY DISHONEST SERVICE….DONT EVEN BOTHER DOWNLOADING THE APP AS ALTHOUGH I STILL HAVE A PAID FOR SUBSCRIPTION DESPITE COUNTLESS ATTEMPTS THE APP REFUSES LOGIN VIA AUTHENTICATOR, BACK UP EMAIL OR ANY OTHER MEANS LIKE STORED PHONES….TOTALLY DISGUSTED WITH THESE PEOPLE AFTER TRUSTING THEM FOR YEARS WITH SENSITIVE AND IMPORTANT EMAILS…..Don’t be ripped off…..It’s a con PURE & SIMPLE!!!!!…….

reviews.title: Useless waste of money
reviews.text: Purchased to try something new, doesn’t work with any Microsoft accounts. Total waste of money. Would give zero stars if possible, feels more like a scam than an actual app.

reviews.title: Notifications don’t work
reviews.text: I really wanted to love this app especially because the star system syncs to Gmail but that doesn’t matter if I don’t even get notified of my emails. I am using this for my business and it is causing me to miss important time sensitive emails. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Decent, Needs Work
reviews.text: Great interface, but let down by (among other things) search functionality that’s somehow even worse than the built-in Mail app.

reviews.title: Goodbye
reviews.text: I’m sorry I read the justification for raising the price from 10$ to 40$. This app has barely updated in forever. The creators have become more and more distant. This is a blatant cash grab and I will not,give them another penny.

reviews.title: 4x price increase forced me to cancel
reviews.text: I use this app daily and have been since their inception. Nice app, slightly better than native iOS app. Felt worth $10/yr, but just noticed my renewal was going to be 4x that. The ROI isn’t there for me. App has been the same for years (at least for how I use it).

reviews.title: Price increase and obnoxious popup
reviews.text: Every time you open it an obnoxious popup pushing the pro subscription covers the screen. They do these despite paying one-time Pro fees in the past.

reviews.title: Massive price increase - I’m out
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this client for almost a decade now. It’s great - I like it. However, the price of my yearly subscription just went up by 5x. I don’t like it that much. I deleted it this afternoon. Such a shame.

Update: I won’t be contacting the developers, as suggested in their reply. If you increase your fees by 500% with no new features then I’m afraid you lose a customer on principle. I’ve moved back to Apple’s Mail app. It’s not as good as Airmail, but it’s more trustworthy.

reviews.title: Annoying Nag Screen
reviews.text:
I purchased this some time ago and only got around to using it now. There’s an annoying nag screen that pops up every few minutes making the app unusable. Not sure what I paid for. Waste of money. Avoid.

Edit (2026) - I received an email asking me to update my review. Well, my advice to the publisher would be to not sell a Lifetime deal then rescind it later. Better to support your early adopters - they got the company to where it is after all.  If there is any kind of nag screen this a breach of the original offer - ie. the full product for a one-off cost. Thanks, but no thanks. OSX mail now has segmentation and works a treat.

reviews.title: O
reviews.text: Yh my .c

reviews.title: Enough already...
reviews.text:
This was the best email aggregator app I found last time I evaluated 3 or 4 years ago (which is damning with the faintest of praise as they are ALL terrible in one way or another). I can happily live with the constant "buy me" popup, and I can JUST ABOUT live with having to completely re-enter all my Microsoft email details every ******* month - what I CAN'T live with is not being able to re-enter ANY of my various disabled outlook / hotmail details at all after a whole week of trying, MANY times over.... and I've tried entering them all as Exchange accounts too - still don't work.

Well I've had enough now. Time to uninstall ANOTHER failed aggregator app, use the ugly as sin Apple app (which at least ******* works I suppose) as a stopgap, and evaluate the other usual suspects in the vain hope one of them has been made vaguely decent since the last time I wasted an hour of my life trying it out...

Seriously: will SOMEBODY PLEASE make ONE decent email app? I'm at the stage where I would HAPPILY pay the 40 quid a year Airmail keeps trying to grift off me for something that looks good, works smoothly, AND can remember all my email accounts' credentials for longer than a few days at a time...

reviews.title: Incessant nagging to upgrade
reviews.text:
I read some great reviews about Airmail and was looking forward to consolidating my numerous accounts into one client. I was interrupted by upgrade popups three times trying to get my first account added. 

Frustrated, I set it aside. Resuming a little later, another popup. Go to settings, another popup. Fine, I give up. If your onboarding experience is this poor, I can’t imagine the app will be any better. 

How am I supposed to know if I want to upgrade if I can’t even get a chance to use the app?

reviews.title: Ok when it works
reviews.text:
The interface is nice, and it’s very functional.. however i have 2 faults with it..

1) I paid for lifetime membership, but then they switched to a subscription model. Sure I can keep using it, but I get a popup asking to pay for it every 5 minutes

2) I decided to pay for the subscription, but Hotmail accounts stop working after a month or two. Authentication fails, and when you try to login it doesn’t take your password and says you’ve entered username or password incorrectly too many times asking for captcha. This doesn’t work however no matter how many times you try.. outlook.com login type doesn’t support passkey login, doesn’t support full
Oauth with 2fa, doesn’t work with app specific passwords, also doesn’t work logging in as exchange account.. can login as office365 account via Authenticator but mail doesn’t actually flow (maybe if you pay for o365 it would?). So the only thing I can do is reset my password to get it to work and then I have to login to about 40 other devices and accounts that link to that account.. got sick of doing this so I will no longer be using this app. It’s a shame too.

reviews.title: Goodbye Airmail
reviews.text: The annual subscription went from $9.99 to $49.99?!?!? Goodbye Airmail!

reviews.title: Rip off
reviews.text: I paid for this service, one time charge for a lifetime, supposedly … then it became a yearly charge of 10.99 and NOW it’s 39.99 a year??? Absolutely not! Goodbye Airmail!!

reviews.title: 400% price increase???
reviews.text:
From $10 per year to $40 per year?
FOR WHAT?

I guess I have until November to find a replacement.

reviews.title: Bumped the price
reviews.text: I used to love this app and recommend everyone I know about it. But, they just bumped the price (even for grandfather accounts that backed this project) from $9.99 to $49.99 even though when started they published that the $9.99 will stay for the life of the project! The support blame the developers and won’t give any more answers. Horrible service and this app is full of bugs. It used to be gold. For every bug I report trying to make it better for me and for them, I got the same answer: It’s the developer’s fault or decision and that I can write it in the Apple review page. What is the support for than? I would love to hear back from the team why you raise the price in 400% to grandfathered accounts and keep ignoring the fact that your initial agreement was $9.99 for the life of the project? We wrote Apple about it of course!

reviews.title: Just keeps getting jankier
reviews.text: Seriously, I’ve been using this app for close to a decade, and it just keeps getting worse and worse. Sending or replying to an email now feels like a patchwork of Instagram-esque bs cut/pasted/duct-taped developer nonsense. Drafts corrupt easily. Replying using a draft swaps your own address for sender. Font sizes and styles change without reason. And good luck getting photos to attach properly. Total junk. If you’re not in the ecosystem, stay away.

reviews.title: Can’t connect to iCloud
reviews.text: 3 hours of trying to connect to iCloud. If this is any sign of the quality I’m not wasting another minute…

reviews.title: Why is it garbage now?
reviews.text: Why?

reviews.title: Freezes during replies
reviews.text: For the last few weeks anytime I try to reply to an email in the Airmail app, it freezes and I can't type or cancel out the reply or anything. I have to shut it down.

reviews.title: Too much reminders to pay
reviews.text: I deleted the app in less than 24 hours. If you’re a paid user, it might work well for you. But for someone who just want a simple email app to try out, and constantly being bombarded with the reminder to upgrade every time I open the app, that’s just too annoying.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Not worth it, pretty basic in my opinion… asking for about 200 a year is absurd for what the app does… I notice a lot of the same negative reviews from others as well. Save your time and don’t bother

reviews.title: Getting prompted to buy pro everytime I open the app made me delete it…
reviews.text: Stop prompting me to get pro every time I open the app if I already said no once.

reviews.title: AVOID: Terrible support, terrible features.
reviews.text: Airmail claims to stream the email process but does anything other than add bloat and glitches. Worse, when you contact support, they are unhelpful and show ZERO interest in doing anything to help paying customers. They could care less if you leave their product. My subscription expires soon, thankfully. I would avoid this product.

reviews.title: Themes
reviews.text: Greedy devs. I would have been find men if they left the day theme the default and made everything else a subscription. But I don’t like the dark theme and I should have access to what I already paid for. App also crashes if an email is stuck in sending mode. Not worth subscribing

reviews.title: Too many begging windows
reviews.text: App seems all fine and all until it just won’t stop with this annoying “get the pro version!” windows. Wouldn’t be so bad once in a while but every time I open the app. Open an email. Go back to the app to re-read a bit of info. Just too much. Never buying the pro version never buying any apps by this developer.

reviews.title: Doesn't work with Gmail
reviews.text: This app does not display archived and labeled items corrected from gmail.

reviews.title: Good app usually but major bug with recent update
reviews.text: Barely usable since most recent update, constantly wants you to sign into Microsoft.

reviews.title: Great on the iPhone, terrible on the iPad.
reviews.text: As other Knott, the iOS 26 version was not executed well. For me that’s the case for my iPad. My iPhone is fine. The iPad is a disaster. I can go and check my spam folder, and see and empty messages, but once I do that, I can’t get back to the inbox. And on the iPad, I’m forced to always view my folders. That’s almost half the screen I really don’t need, give me a way to push that out of the way.

reviews.title: “WAS” my go to email app…
reviews.text: This WAS my go to email app since day one when I was released. Now with the most recent updates it’s trash. Folders are gone, not visible and not accessible on the iPhone version. Yeah they made it “pretty” I suppose if that means anything… but to real users this app has been severely crippled in use. I’ll give it a few weeks and see if the developers care and do anything. Otherwise I’m gone to Spark…

reviews.title: The Last Udate Broke It🥴
reviews.text:
I have been using it every day for almost a year, but the last update makes it difficult to mark messages as spam, block, move to any folder and it's just slow and awkward - especially on mobile. On desktop, it's difficult to respond to an email. Once you make a draft, it's difficult to resume it. It's become way less intuitive. I bought a one year subscription, but I won't renew if they don't fix this before I find an alternative that works with all my email accounts. 🥹 
I really liked it -- until many days of hitting walls. I decided to check the reviews to see if I was the only one affected. Unfortunately, it seems to be unilateral with others experiencing the same thing. Dangit! Migrating emails is a pain. 😫

reviews.title: Broken on Mini since iPad os 26
reviews.text:
1) When composing an email, the window will suddenly disappear under the main window.
2) If I start a reply to an email, or even just open one, there's no way to cancel or close it. 
3) The buttons for setting signature, etc, tend to disappear off the bottom.
I’ve tried to get support but found the chat process unworkable. I just want to raise a ticket by email.

reviews.title: Fatal error on replies
reviews.text: There’s an annoying bug on replies.  I couldn’t reply messages, font size went big and all of a sudden I have a composer fatal error message pop up and it failed.  Also current arrangement of putting labels under the sub menus is really inconvenient.

reviews.title: Good app less useful with latest update
reviews.text: Have used the pro version for years. Tried many other clients along the way and kept coming back to this one. The feature that kept me coming back was the unified inbox that had the icon for each account visible. Incredibly helpful when bouncing between nearly a dozen different email accounts and trying to keep tabs on them all. The search function was never great but the access to every account and every folder from the unified inbox was worth it. The new update, however, took away direct folder access making the mobile app significantly less useful.

reviews.title: The worst
reviews.text: If you don’t pay and continue with the free version you are hounded, delayed, frozen and generally screwed with. A class action lawsuit might put these people out of business.
